BiblicalUsage: Perah is a hole dug in the earth, the mole's burrow. In the day of the LORD, a man shall cast his idols of silver and gold to the moles and to the bats, to the dark holes where they belong.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that idols end in the dark: what men worshipped in the light they will throw to the moles when the LORD arises.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
